notes.title: v1.0.44 *MAJOR UPDATE*
notes.content:
Character Updates:
- Added directional attacks for each button combination for each character (attack 1, 2, & 3) and level (air, standing, & crouching) (example: ↑ + attack 1)
- Added unique combo linking for each character (attack 1, attack 2, attack 3 & special)
- Added combo breaker technique (← + special + special (when close range and > 50% power)
- Added quick stand from fall, tap forward (→) when far or tap back (←) when close to quick stand.
- Added move link between forward sprint (→ + →) and side step (↑ + ↑ or ↓ + ↓)
- Added grabs on attack 1 and 2 (← + attack 1 or ← + attack 2)
- Tech block basic grabs by matching the grab input during the start up frame (← + attack 1 or ← + attack 2)
- Tech block super grabs by matching the grab input during the start up frame  (← + special)
- Global cooldown created for special moves, set to 5 seconds (super/ultimate moves have no cool down)
- Created 3 global super moves that every character can access at 100% power
- Fixed timing for active frames, block, and stun values on ultimate moves
- Fixed timing for active frames, block, and stun values on special moves
- Fixed timing for active frames, block, and stun values on basic moves


Game-play Updates:
- Simplified button layout (4 buttons - attack 1, attack 2, attack 3, & special) 
- Simplified block (hold ←)
- Added parry ability to all characters (tap ← during block frames to activate)
- Added ability to counter attacks (attack during active frames to activate)
- Adjusted gauge increase rate for block, hit, attack, & parry
- Redesigned AI instructions with 5 levels (Very Easy: mostly only blocks)
- Set 3 levels of blocking (crouch, stand, air)

General Updates:
- Added text notifications for combos and special moves
- Added HP and Power text values to GUI
- Added default controller config visual map to pause menu


Join us on discord:
https://discord.gg/PoliticalPunchers

notes.title: v1.0.42 *MAJOR CHARACTER & GAMEPLAY UPDATES*
notes.content:
[b]Character Updates:[/b]
*Corrected gauge requirements on special moves for all characters. Basic specials cost 50% and super specials cost 100%.
*Adjusted combo move links and timings for all characters.
Increased total hit points by 10% for all characters.
*Created secondary inputs for special moves. Same directional patterns with a different execution buttons. Now utilizing punch and kick buttons for execution also.
*Increased delay on ranged attacks for all characters.
*Adjusted forward drift on most attacks for all characters.
*Corrected GW Kush ability to kick.
*GW airsoft shots now occur in combinations, not on basic attacks.

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
Corrected auto rotation bug.
*Further refined AI behavior.
*Adjusted air juggle configuration globally.

[b]General Updates:[/b]
Touchpad now unhides cursor, same as the mouse does.
Fixed character model display seam tearing.

[b]Join us on discord:[/b][i] https://discord.gg/PoliticalPunchers[/i]

notes.title: Political Punchers: 2024 Arena - Patch v1.0.41
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]:
• Optimized graphics quality for Low Performance Mode.
• Updated AI settings for improved behavior.
• Added 'very easy' mode for noob streamers (Sodapoppin).

[b]GUI Updates:[/b]
• Cursor now hides during gameplay, resumes with mouse activity.
• Added options to hide GUI for better screenshots and videos in the main Options menu.
• Added options to adjust camera height and default distance on the Options & Pause menus.
• Added option to quickly change controls from the pause menu.

[b]Character Updates:[/b]
• Adjusted projectile interruption rate with all characters.
• Adjusted delay on Crouching Punch (L/H) and Crouching Kick (L) for all characters.
• Reduced Overlord Klinton total hit points.
• Adjusted Overlord Klinton armor bonus during special attacks.
• Adjusted Sleepy Joey's armor bonus during certain attacks.
• Fixed Sleepy Joey's stand up attack knockback distance.
• Fixed Donald Trompster's basic attack linking configuration.
• Fixed Yoballer's 'Hope and Change' kick to land both kicks if distanced correctly.
• Fixed Yoballer's 'Yes We Can' spinning kick to have proper evasion during the spin.
• Yoballer's 'Drone Strike' now destroys Alligators as well as German Shepard's.

[b]Online Gameplay Updates:[/b]
• Added total online player count to Network Connected screen.

[b]Controller Updates:[/b]
• Fixed default gamepad controls: [i]Bumper = Special button[/i] and [i]Trigger = Block button (hold)[/i]
